answer: A payout is split which means 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ember schedule is applied in dawn and island makes public each instalment. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3271 identities would post 3312 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
